run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum number of segments of lengths a, b, c that fit into length n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming function that maximizes segment count for a given rod length
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function DP approach using an array to track max segments at each length
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to reduce the DP array size from n+10 to n+1 for tighter memory usage
